dashboard.welcome: Welcome, {{name}}! Here's what's coming up in {{household}}.

shoppingList.title: Shopping List
shoppingList.noLists: No shopping lists yet — create one above.
shoppingList.favoriteLabel: Favorite list (the Cooking Plan will add ingredients here)
shoppingList.confirmDeleteList: Delete the list "{{name}}" and all its items?
shoppingList.historyEmpty: Nothing bought yet — items appear here once you tick them off a list.
shoppingList.historyFor: History of "{{list}}" — pick another list above to see its history.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.importSocialHint: Paste a link to an Instagram Reel, TikTok, or YouTube Short -- the spoken audio is transcribed and combined with the post's caption.
recipes.importSocialRequirementHint: Requires server-side video transcription to be configured (see Settings -> Connected services).
recipes.importPhotoHint: Take or choose photo(s) of a recipe -- multiple pages are combined into one recipe.
recipes.importPhotoReadFailed: Could not read that image. Please try another.
recipes.importNoPhotos: Add at least one photo first.
recipes.importTextHint: Paste any recipe text -- e.g. an Instagram caption, a forwarded message, or text copied from anywhere.
recipes.importUrlHint: Paste a link to a recipe web page.
recipes.importFailed: Could not extract a recipe. Please try again or enter it manually.
recipes.importReviewHint: Check the extracted details below before saving -- AI/automatic extraction isn't always perfect.
recipes.empty: No recipes yet — add your first one!
recipes.saveFailed: Could not save the recipe. Please check the fields and try again.
recipes.cookLogFailed: Could not log this. Please try again.
recipes.addedMetaUnknown: someone no longer in the household

cookingPlan.title: Cooking Plan
cookingPlan.planningBanner: You are planning the week {{range}}. “Finish plan” creates the cooking tasks and ticks off the planning reminder.
cookingPlan.finished_one: {{count}} cooking task created — assign it in the household plan.
cookingPlan.finished_other: {{count}} cooking tasks created — assign them in the household plan.
cookingPlan.finishedNothingNew: Nothing new to create — every dish already has a task.
cookingPlan.noMeals: There are no meal types yet. Add them under Settings → Recipes & Shopping Lists.
cookingPlan.noSuggestions: No matching recipes — add some recipes first.
cookingPlan.leftoversEmpty: No dish to cook is planned before this point yet.
cookingPlan.freeDishHint: For ready meals, eating out or anything without a recipe: just a name. It gets a cooking task, and when you finish the plan you can put the name on the shopping list.
cookingPlan.leftoversOrderError: Leftovers must come after the dish: on a later day, or at a later meal on the same day.
cookingPlan.leftoversNoSlot: There is no meal left this week after this dish.
cookingPlan.saveFailed: That did not work. Please try again.
cookingPlan.householdStepBanner: Step 1 of the household planning ({{range}}): plan the meals first. “Finish plan” creates the cooking tasks, then the household planning continues.

tasks.title: Household Plan
tasks.backlogEmpty: Nothing here — drag a task in, or add one without a day.
tasks.configSaveNote: Changes above save immediately as you make them — Save and Cancel both just take you back to the calendar.
tasks.nowEditing: Editing — Save to apply changes, or Cancel to stop editing.
tasks.confirmDeleteWithInstances: "{{title}}" has {{count}} scheduled occurrence(s). Delete it and all of them?

recurrence.noPreferredDayHint: No preferred day — it'll land in the backlog each time and can be dragged onto whichever day makes sense that week.

vouchers.title: Vouchers
vouchers.noActiveVouchers: No vouchers yet -- add one above.
vouchers.valueLockedAfterRedemption: Value can no longer be edited once a redemption has been logged.
vouchers.redeemInvalidAmount: Enter an amount between 0 and the remaining balance.

packingLists.title: Packing Lists
packingLists.createFailed: Could not create the list. Please try again.
packingLists.copyFailed: Could not copy the list. Please try again.
packingLists.editFailed: Could not save changes. Please try again.
packingLists.deleteFailed: Could not delete the list. Please try again.
packingLists.archiveFailed: Could not update the archive status. Please try again.
packingLists.noUpcomingLists: No upcoming packing lists yet -- add one above.
packingLists.emptyList: Nothing on this list yet -- add something above.
packingLists.nonParticipantWarning: {{name}} is not listed as a participant on this trip.

weeklyPlanning.title: Weekly Household Planning
weeklyPlanning.description: This decides when the recurring reminder to plan next week's tasks shows up. It also appears as a task card on that day.
weeklyPlanning.finishConfirm_one: {{count}} task for next week still has no day or no person assigned. Finish planning anyway?
weeklyPlanning.finishConfirm_other: {{count}} tasks for next week still have no day or no person assigned. Finish planning anyway?
weeklyPlanning.onlyThisOrNextWeek: Weekly planning is only available for the current or next week — use the arrows to get there first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.googleCalendarHint: One-way, read-only: connect a shared household calendar to see it overlaid in the weekly plan while assigning tasks. Nothing is ever written back to Google.
settings.googleCalendarFailed: Could not connect Google Calendar. Please try again.
settings.googleCalendarConfirmDisconnect: Disconnect Google Calendar? The synced overlay will disappear from the weekly plan.
settings.serviceStatusHint: Read-only overview of the optional external services configured via the server's .env file -- keys themselves aren't shown or editable here.
settings.serviceEmailNotConfigured: Not configured -- notification emails are only printed to the server console.
settings.serviceWebPushNotConfigured: Not configured -- push notifications are unavailable.
settings.serviceCategorizationConfigured: Configured -- used as a fallback for shopping items the built-in dictionary doesn't recognize, and to extract recipes from photos, pasted text, web pages, and social media captions.
settings.serviceCategorizationNotConfigured: Not configured -- shopping categorization falls back to the built-in dictionary only, and recipe import (photo/text/URL/social) is unavailable.
settings.serviceSocialImportConfigured: Configured -- Instagram/TikTok/YouTube Short links can be transcribed when importing a recipe.
settings.serviceSocialImportMissingFfmpeg: OPENAI_API_KEY is set, but ffmpeg is missing on the server -- audio can't be extracted yet.
settings.serviceSocialImportNotConfigured: Not configured -- social media video import falls back to pasting the caption as text.
settings.timezoneHint: Used for "today"/"overdue" and, later, reminder times -- not necessarily the server's own timezone.

notificationTypes.shopping_items_added: New items added to a shopping list

settings.enablePushOnDevice: Enable push notifications on this device
settings.pushEnabledOnDevice: Push notifications are enabled on this device.
settings.pushNotSupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications.
settings.pushPermissionDenied: Notification permission was denied in the browser.
settings.pushEnableFailed: Couldn't enable push notifications. Try again.
settings.notificationLanguageHint: Applies to emails and push notifications, independent of the app language.
settings.pushIosHint: Push also arrives when the app is closed or you are logged out. On iPhone this only works if you add the page to the Home Screen, open it there, log in and enable push here.

recipeConfig.title: Recipes & Shopping Lists
recipeConfig.hint: Labels, meal types and units have a German and an English name (English is optional — German is shown when it is empty). Also the ingredient catalogue used by recipes and shopping lists.
recipeConfig.name: Name
recipeConfig.inUse: This is still used by one or more recipes and cannot be deleted.
recipeConfig.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.

packingBuckets.title: Trip Buckets
packingBuckets.hint: Templates like "Staying overnight" or "Summer vacation" -- add one to a packing list as a whole instead of typing every item by hand. Shared household config, visible and editable by both of you.
packingBuckets.emptyBucket: No items in this bucket yet.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.loadFailed: Could not load the stats. Please try again.
analytics.noData: No data yet in this period.

tasks.title: Household Tasks
tasks.onTimeTrend: Completed on time per calendar week

vouchers.title: Vouchers
vouchers.activeTotal: Current total value of active vouchers

shoppingDialog.title: Ingredients to shopping list
shoppingDialog.failed: Could not add the ingredients. Please try again.

cookingSettings.title: Cooking plan settings
cookingSettings.hint: Decides which meals appear in the weekly plan and how the recipe suggestions are ranked.
cookingSettings.longAgoCount: Number of “not cooked in a while”
cookingSettings.failed: Could not save. Please check the values.

mealPlanning.title: Weekly Meal Planning
mealPlanning.description: Decides when the recurring reminder to plan next week’s meals shows up. It also appears as a task on that day; “Plan now” opens the cooking plan.

cookingStep.title: Meal planning
cookingStep.explanation: Plan the week’s meals first — every dish becomes a cooking task you can assign right afterwards.
cookingStep.none: Nothing is planned for this week yet.
cookingStep.drafts_one: {{count}} dish is planned but has no cooking task yet.
cookingStep.drafts_other: {{count}} dishes are planned but have no cooking task yet.
